rules.title: Set up both
rules.description: Use the Synthetic Monitoring CLI, review your check, and choose your Frontend Observability setup journey.

rules.title: Synthetic Monitoring
rules.description: Open Synthetic Monitoring to explore checks and monitor your website's availability and response time.

rules.title: Frontend Observability
rules.description: Open Frontend Observability to explore applications and understand the experience of people using your website.

blocks.title: Digital Experience Monitoring
blocks.description: Understand your website from the outside in with Synthetic Monitoring and the inside out with Frontend Observability.

blocks.content: Start with the Synthetic Monitoring CLI, then connect your frontend with lightweight guidance.
Start with either product and add the other whenever you are ready.
